title: alsine verna var. borealis
intro: Alsine verna var. borealis, commonly known as Wood Sorrel, is a perennial plant species belonging to the saxifrage family. It is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating digestive issues, such as diarrhea and gastritis, due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Wood Sorrel include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and astringent properties, which help in soothing and protecting the mucous membranes. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthraquinones, flavonoids, and tannins, which contribute to its medicinal effects.
